_meta.description: Individual player climate profiles for all 48 WC 2026 squads.

climateTierScale.1 – Cold: ≤9 °C avg season temp (Scotland, Scandinavia, northern Canada)
climateTierScale.3 – Warm: 15–19 °C (France, Italy, Portugal, Spain, South America, Japan/Korea)
climateTierScale.4 – Hot/Dry: 20–24 °C (Turkey, Mexico, southern MLS, South Africa, Australia North)
climateTierScale.5 – Hot/Humid: ≥25 °C (Brazil, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, West Africa, Iraq, Qatar, Panama)

notes: avgSeasonTemp_C is the average match-day temperature during the playing season (Aug–May N. hemisphere).
Clubs not found in the specific lookup are resolved to the country's average temperature.
climateTier is used by weatherService.js as an input to the heat adjustment formula.
